# Training-loop governors

Feedback controllers over loop-level knobs, each driven by an endogenous signal native to its knob - a feedback device, not a search. Each entry is a builder ``(batch_size, target_batch_size, val_every, sequence_multiplier_tiers) -> Callback``. Unset keeps the static accumulation factor.

Namespace: ``registry.namespace("governors")``, declared in ``praxis.governors`` (1 entries)

Selected with ``--governor`` (default: unset).

## `gns_batch`

Governs the effective batch (rows per optimizer step) by tracking the measured gradient
noise scale. ``batch_size`` and ``target_batch_size`` both become ceilings (one
microbatch, one step), and ``praxis/data/batch_schedule.py`` factorizes the governed row
count against them.
